chapters.name: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
keyPoints: Microsporogenesis: Sporogenous tissue $\xrightarrow{\text{meiosis}}$ Microspore tetrad (haploid, $n$).

Megasporogenesis & Female Gametophyte (Embryo Sac): Megaspore Mother Cell (MMC, $2n$) in micropylar nucellus $\xrightarrow{\text{meiosis}}$ 4 linear megaspores ($n$). 3 degenerate; 1 functional megaspore develops into embryo sac.
7-celled, 8-nucleate mature embryo sac: Egg apparatus (1 Egg cell + 2 Synergids), Central cell (2 polar nuclei), Antipodal cells (3 cells).
Double Fertilisation: Syngamy: Male gamete ($n$) + Egg cell ($n$) $\to$ Zygote ($2n$). Triple Fusion: Male gamete ($n$) + 2 Polar nuclei ($2n$) $\to$ Primary Endosperm Nucleus (PEN, $3n$).
Embryogeny: Zygote ($2n$) $\to$ Proembryo $\to$ Globular embryo $\to$ Heart-shaped embryo $\to$ Mature embryo.

chapters.name: Human Reproduction
keyPoints: Spermatogenesis: Spermatogonia ($2n, 46$) $\xrightarrow{\text{mitosis}}$ Primary Spermatocyte ($2n, 46$) $\xrightarrow{\text{Meiosis I}}$ 2 Secondary Spermatocytes ($n, 23$) $\xrightarrow{\text{Meiosis II}}$ 4 Spermatids ($n, 23$) $\xrightarrow{\text{Spermiogenesis}}$ 4 Spermatozoa ($n, 23$)

Oogenesis: Oogonia ($2n$) $\xrightarrow{\text{mitosis in fetal ovary}}$ Primary Oocytes ($2n$) $\xrightarrow{\text{arrested at Prophase-I}}$ Secondary Oocyte ($n$) + 1st Polar Body ($n$) $\to$ Graafian follicle $\xrightarrow{\text{LH surge, Day 14}}$ Ovulation
Menstrual Cycle Phases: Menstrual Phase (Days 1–5), Follicular / Proliferative Phase (Days 6–13), Ovulatory Phase (Day 14), Luteal / Secretory Phase (Days 15–28).
Cleavage & Implantation: Zygote ($2n$) $\xrightarrow{\text{cleavage}}$ Morula (8-16 blastomeres) $\xrightarrow{\text{cavitation}}$ Blastocyst (Trophoblast outer layer + Inner Cell Mass)

chapters.name: Reproductive Health
keyPoints: Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP): Legalized in India in 1971. Safe in 1st trimester (up to 12 weeks).

Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART): IVF-ET (In Vitro Fertilisation & Embryo Transfer), ZIFT (Zygote Intra-Fallopian Transfer), IUT (Intra-Uterine Transfer), GIFT (Gamete Intra-Fallopian Transfer), ICSI (Intra-Cytoplasmic Sperm Injection), AI / IUI (Artificial Insemination / Intra-Uterine Insemination).

chapters.name: Principles of Inheritance and Variation
keyPoints: Monohybrid Cross ($TT \times tt \to Tt$): Phenotypic Ratio: $3 : 1$ (Tall : Dwarf). Genotypic Ratio: $1 : 2 : 1$ ($TT : Tt : tt$).

Dihybrid Cross ($RRYY \times rryy \to RrYy$): Phenotypic Ratio: $9 : 3 : 3 : 1$. Number of genotypes = $3^n = 9$; Number of phenotypes = $2^n = 4$ (where $n = \text{number of heterozygous gene pairs} = 2$).
Incomplete Dominance: F$_1$ phenotype intermediate between parents ($RR$ Red $\times rr$ White $\to Rr$ Pink; F$_2$ phenotypic & genotypic ratio = $1 : 2 : 1$).
Sex Determination Mechanisms: Male Heterogamety: XX-XY (Humans, Drosophila), XX-XO (Grasshopper). Female Heterogamety: ZZ-ZW (Birds). Haplodiploidy: Honey bees.
Sickle-Cell Anaemia: Autosomal recessive ($Hb^A Hb^S$). Point mutation: GAG $\to$ GUG substitution at $6^{\text{th}}$ codon of $\beta$-globin gene; Glutamic acid $\to$ Valine.

chapters.name: Molecular Basis of Inheritance
keyPoints: Chargaff's Rule: $[A] = [T]$, $[G] = [C] \implies \frac{[A]+[G]}{[T]+[C]} = 1$.
Griffith’s Transformation Experiment (1928): Heat-killed S + Live R injected in mice $\to$ Mice die; live S bacteria recovered. Proved transforming principle.
Hershey-Chase Experiment (1952): $^{35}\text{S}$ labelled protein coat and $^{32}\text{P}$ labelled DNA proved DNA is viral genetic material.
Meselson & Stahl Experiment (1958): Proved semiconservative replication in E. coli using heavy isotope $^{15}\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}$ and $^{14}\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}$.
Transcription Unit: Promoter ($5'$-end of coding strand), Structural Gene, Terminator ($3'$-end of coding strand). Template strand: $3' \to 5'$; Coding strand: $5' \to 3'$.

chapters.name: Evolution
keyPoints: Hardy-Weinberg Equation: $p + q = 1 \implies p^2 + 2pq + q^2 = 1$ where $p = \text{freq}(A)$, $q = \text{freq}(a)$; $p^2 = \text{freq}(AA)$, $2pq = \text{freq}(Aa)$, $q^2 = \text{freq}(aa)$.
Urey-Miller Experiment (1953): Electric discharge at $800^\circ\text{C}$ in gas mixture ($\text{CH}_4 : \text{NH}_3 : \text{H}_2 = 2:1:2$ + water vapour) $\to$ synthesis of amino acids.

chapters.name: Human Health and Disease
keyPoints: Innate Immunity: Physical Barriers, Physiological Barriers, Cellular Barriers, Cytokine Barriers.
Acquired Immunity: Humoral Immune Response (B-lymphocytes produce antibodies), Cell-Mediated Immunity (T-lymphocytes).
AIDS Mechanism: Viral RNA converts to viral DNA via reverse transcriptase $\to$ integrates into host genome $\to$ new viruses infect Helper T-lymphocytes (T$_H$, CD4).

chapters.name: Microbes in Human Welfare
keyPoints: BOD (Biochemical Oxygen Demand): Amount of O$_2$ consumed if all organic matter in 1 L water oxidised by bacteria; indicator of pollution.
Biogas Production: Anaerobic degradation by methanogens $\to$ Biogas ($\text{CH}_4 + \text{CO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{S}$).

chapters.name: Biotechnology: Principles and Processes
keyPoints: Restriction Endonucleases: Cleave phosphodiester bonds on both strands away from centre of symmetry (e.g., EcoRI cuts $5'\text{-G}\downarrow\text{AATTC-3}'$).
PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction): Denaturation ($94\text{--}96^\circ\text{C}$), Annealing ($50\text{--}60^\circ\text{C}$), Extension ($72^\circ\text{C}$).

chapters.name: Biotechnology and Its Applications
keyPoints: Genetically Engineered Insulin: Eli Lilly synthesised two separate DNA sequences for A and B chains, cloned them in E. coli plasmids, extracted chains separately, and combined them via disulphide bonds.

RNA Interference (RNAi): Nematode-specific genes introduced into host plant $\to$ produces both sense and anti-sense RNA $\to$ forms double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) $\to$ initiates cellular defense RNAi $\to$ silences specific nematode mRNA.

chapters.name: Organisms and Populations
keyPoints: Exponential Growth: $\frac{dN}{dt} = (b - d)N = rN \implies N_t = N_0 e^{rt}$
Verhulst-Pearl Logistic Growth: $\frac{dN}{dt} = rN\left(\frac{K - N}{K}\right)$
Population Dynamics Equation: $N_{t+1} = N_t + [(B + I) - (D + E)]$

chapters.name: Ecosystem
keyPoints: Net Primary Productivity (NPP): $\text{NPP} = \text{GPP} - R$ (where $R = \text{respiratory loss}$).

chapters.name: Biodiversity and Conservation
keyPoints: Species-Area Relationship: $\log S = \log C + Z \log A \quad \left(S = C A^Z\right)$
